system.description:
Your influence reaches into the very memories of your victim. Gazing into their eyes, you draw out their recollections and rewrite them, erasing whole blocks of the past or replacing them with constructions of your own.

Make a Mental Challenge (retest Intimidation). With success you may erase or alter up to 15 minutes of memory; additional blocks require additional challenges. While you hold the subject's gaze and they are unthreatened, they remain pacified and unable to resist. Record your Mental Traits at the time of alteration, as later uses may overcome your work. You may also expose falsified memories by winning a Static Mental Challenge against the previous dominator's Mental Traits, then restore or re-alter them. You cannot destroy actual capabilities (only the memory of learning them), and you cannot use this power on your own mind.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
